description: This file defines logic for automatically enabling plugins in a software system based on configuration, environment, and plugin registry data. It includes types, functions for resolving plugin states, and functions to detect and apply auto-enable candidates.

classes.name: PluginAutoEnableCandidate
classes.description: Type representing different plugin auto-enable scenarios, such as channel configuration, browser configuration, provider authentication, model configuration, web fetch provider, web search, web fetch, plugin tools, and ACP runtime.

classes.name: PluginAutoEnableResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of auto-enabling plugins, including the updated configuration, list of changes, and reasons for auto-enablement.

methods.name: resolveAutoEnableProviderPluginIds
methods.description: Resolves provider plugin IDs based on the plugin registry and bundled provider IDs.

methods.name: collectModelRefs
methods.description: Collects model references from the configuration's agents section.

methods.name: extractProviderFromModelRef
methods.description: Extracts provider ID from a model reference string.

methods.name: isProviderConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a provider is configured in the current configuration.

methods.name: hasPluginOwnedWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Checks if a plugin has web search configuration in the current config.

methods.name: hasPluginOwnedWebFetchConfig
methods.description: Checks if a plugin has web fetch configuration in the current config.

methods.name: hasPluginOwnedToolConfig
methods.description: Checks if a plugin has tool configuration in the current config.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginsWithOwnedWebSearch
methods.description: Resolves plugins that own web search capabilities.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginsWithOwnedWebFetch
methods.description: Resolves plugins that own web fetch capabilities.

methods.name: resolvePluginIdForConfiguredWebFetchProvider
methods.description: Resolves plugin ID for a given web fetch provider ID.

methods.name: buildChannelToPluginIdMap
methods.description: Builds a map from channel IDs to plugin IDs from the plugin registry.

methods.name: splitEnvPaths
methods.description: Splits environment variable paths into an array of strings.

methods.name: resolveExternalCatalogPaths
methods.description: Resolves paths to external plugin catalogs based on environment variables.

methods.name: parseExternalCatalogChannelEntries
methods.description: Parses external catalog JSON data into channel entries.

methods.name: resolveExternalCatalogPreferOver
methods.description: Resolves preferred plugin IDs over a channel from external catalog files.

methods.name: resolvePluginIdForChannel
methods.description: Resolves plugin ID for a given channel ID, considering third-party channels.

methods.name: collectCandidateChannelIds
methods.description: Collects candidate channel IDs from configuration and environment.

methods.name: hasConfiguredWebSearchPluginEntry
methods.description: Checks if web search plugin entry is configured in the config.

methods.name: hasConfiguredWebFetchPluginEntry
methods.description: Checks if web fetch plugin entry is configured in the config.

methods.name: configMayNeedPluginManifestRegistry
methods.description: Determines if the current config may require plugin manifest registry data.

methods.name: configMayNeedPluginAutoEnable
methods.description: Determines if the current config may need auto-enabling of plugins based on environment.

methods.name: listContainsBrowser
methods.description: Checks if a list contains the string 'browser'.

methods.name: toolPolicyReferencesBrowser
methods.description: Checks if tool policies reference 'browser'.

methods.name: hasBrowserToolReference
methods.description: Checks if the configuration references the browser tool.

methods.name: hasExplicitBrowserPluginEntry
methods.description: Checks if the explicit browser plugin entry exists in the config.

methods.name: resolveBrowserAutoEnableSource
methods.description: Resolves the source of auto-enabling the browser plugin.

methods.name: resolvePluginAutoEnableCandidateReason
methods.description: Provides a human-readable reason for a plugin auto-enable candidate.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredPlugins
methods.description: Resolves which plugins are configured and should be auto-enabled based on current config and environment.

methods.name: isPluginExplicitlyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if a plugin is explicitly disabled in the config.

methods.name: isPluginDenied
methods.description: Checks if a plugin is denied in the config.

methods.name: resolvePreferredOverIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs that are preferred over a given plugin ID.

methods.name: shouldSkipPreferredPluginAutoEnable
methods.description: Determines if auto-enabling should be skipped due to plugin preferences.

methods.name: registerPluginEntry
methods.description: Registers a plugin as enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: formatAutoEnableChange
methods.description: Formats a string describing the auto-enable change for a plugin.

methods.name: detectPluginAutoEnableCandidates
methods.description: Detects which plugins should be auto-enabled based on current configuration and environment.

methods.name: materializePluginAutoEnableCandidates
methods.description: Applies auto-enable candidates to produce a new configuration and record reasons.

methods.name: applyPluginAutoEnable
methods.description: Main function to detect and apply plugin auto-enablement based on current config and environment.
